collection.title: SEAT Leon Hatchback 2005 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The SEAT Leon Hatchback 2005 to 2009 model requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Pinch Tab arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this Leon, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
